statements.restated: The document states that changing the drum set initialises every drum setup parameter.
statements.readAs: The note is printed under the drum setup table and names that table's parameters, so it is taken to reach every row of it.
statements.open: It states what one message does to a table, which is a reset by another name and is the shape of thing the archive's reset probe measures. Nothing has put a drum set change to this unit and read these addresses back, so what the document states here stands beside no measurement at all.

statements.restated: The document states that one drum instrument cannot use chorus send and delay send at the same time.
statements.readAs: The note names the two parameters, and the two rows carrying those names are the whole of what it reaches. It is about the pair rather than about either of them, which is why it is here rather than restated twice as a qualification.
statements.open: The write probe writes one address at a time and reads it back, so it would find both of these accepting a value and say nothing about what happens when both hold one. What would answer it is an audible comparison with each set alone and with both set together.
